## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`

PR #34640 (cards #34608 and #34610), docs only, 2 files, +112 −12 against `main`. Read: both card bodies and every comment (rulings 6937495221 and 6937505798, claim 6937569040, os-dev-report 6939252211, claim amendment 6939362908, claim 6939422606), the PR body, the net diff, and the check-runs on the head. Read to judge, never reviewed: the first consumer #34665 at `910dbebc9f71858b95c71fbc54b30b066f3bb911` and the live tree on `origin/main`.

`Security-touching: yes` because the A3 hunk teaches two security behaviours the path names do not show: a Builder handoff prompt travels only as navigation state and never in a URL (objectui#12493, the defence against a one-click link that auto-sends a prompt), and how shared links resolve.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-sets and published surface: none changed. The diff is prose in two ADR files; no schema, no exported symbol, no route, no locale key. Right.
- Route surface the ADR describes: A3 keeps `/ai`, `/ai/:agent` and `/ai/:agent/:conversationId` with `?package=` and `?new=` routed. That is the route set `ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx` declares on `main` and keeps in #34665 (now rendering `AiAddressRedirect`). No address is narrowed. Right.
- ADR index: `docs/adr/README.md` row for ADR-0037 is built from the title and the `Status` line, and neither moved (the amendment is a new `Amended` line). No regeneration owed. Right.
- Gate verdicts, read off the check-runs on the head at review time: 15 `success` (among them Check Documentation Links, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Dogfood Regression Gate, Check PR Size, the newer PR-body guards run), 15 `skipped` (Check Changeset among them, under `skip-changeset`), 1 `cancelled` (the superseded PR-body guards run; its successor is green), 0 failures, and 13 still `in_progress` (Lint · repo and tooling gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, the Type Check families, Test UI, Test Core, Build and E2E UI, Lint UI, Type Check UI). No gate is red; the pending ones are not yet verdicts and the seat reads them before any ready or queue step.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no

The PR publishes nothing: two ADR files, no package source, no generated baseline. Label `skip-changeset` is present and Check Changeset is `skipped`; the PR body's `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` agree with the diff. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- os-dev-report 6939252211, deviation "ADR PR amends ADR-0037 only in boundary rule 3 … the split-view Decision is left for #34610": no longer true at this head. The second commit amends ADR-0037's Decision and the `LiveCanvas` host item, as ruling 6937505798 scopes them into this amendment. Answered by the ruling.
- Claim surface: claim amendment 6939362908 still records the ADR PR's surface as "the ui ADR-0057 file plus that ADR-0037 sentence" (rule 3 only). The head edits three more places in ADR-0037 (the `Amended` header line, the Decision paragraph, the Phase 2 host item). The ruling authorises the content; the claim record is behind the diff. Escalated to the seat: a second claim amendment on #34608 naming the wider ADR-0037 surface.
- Deviation "Studio's copilot maximize still navigates to `/ai/build?package=…`, which now lands on Home with the drawer maximized": not recorded in A3. See S1.
- Deviation "drawer state is per-tab sessionStorage, not a URL parameter": recorded in A3 (Addresses, Consequences). Answered.
- `open_questions` on 6939252211 ("#34628 and this PR conflict in ConsoleLayout.tsx"): about the code PR #34665; this diff touches no code. Not this PR's to answer.
- SQL push-down (AGENTS.md Prime Directive 5): no query, no id materialisation, no in-app join in the diff. Nothing to flag.

### ④ Design judgment

**`ui/docs/adr/0057-console-ai-chat-one-conversation-docked.md` (Amendment A3)**

Against ruling 6937495221: every ruled item is recorded (one right-side drawer, in-place maximize that restores, bottom-right button removed and the robot the one entry, old `/ai` and `/ai/build` links opening the drawer, A1 kept, ADR-0063 compatible), and the four overridden texts the ruling names (§3, A2 Maximize, open questions 2 and 5) are each struck with a pointer. The quoted ruling word is verbatim.

Against the first consumer #34665: the #34608 half holds clause by clause. One container hosted by both layouts (`useConsoleChatDock` in `ConsoleLayout` and `HomeLayout`); rail on desktop and bottom sheet on a phone; the robot toggles with the address unchanged and carries the plan marker (`AssistantTopBarButton`, objectui#11666); `ConsoleChatbotFab` and its corner-yield tests deleted; maximize turns the same element into a fixed layer with no remount (`ChatDockPanel`); leaving the page restores the rail (the `page` effect); history behind a button at rail width; the three `/ai…` routes render `AiAddressRedirect`, which arms target, expanded and full window per tab and lands on `useHomePath()`; the handoff rides navigation state only (`chatDockTarget.ts`, objectui#12493); Home and app-management entries open the drawer through `useOpenAssistant`.

M1 (must-fix) — the Building bullet, and ADR-0037's amended Decision with it, define the build canvas and the one publish control in terms that hold only for changes to a published app; for a NEW app they contradict Accepted ADR-0045 and the live tree, and implemented as written they leave the new app with no working Publish. A3 says the main area "shows the app itself in the shell's draft mode (`?preview=draft`)", that a new build after binding "shows that app's draft", and that "the screen has one publish control, the shell's draft bar, and one change count, the current app's (package's) unpublished changes". In the tree a new build is MATERIALIZED, not drafted: ADR-0045 §5 ("The Live Canvas no longer depends on [`?preview=draft`] for builds"; edits to a still-unpublished app "materialize directly into the unpublished app") and §7 (the canvas shows `/apps/NAME`, the real app, behind an "Unpublished app" banner whose Publish is a visibility flip). The code agrees: `ChatbotEnhanced` fires `onBuildMaterialized`, `LiveCanvas`'s `materialized` prop drops the preview flag, and `ConsoleLayout` renders TWO bars, `DraftPreviewBar` (`?preview=draft`, publishes pending drafts) and `UnpublishedAppBar` (`app._unpublished`, flips the gate). `UnpublishedAppBar` returns null in preview mode, and `usePublishAllDrafts` answers "Nothing to publish" when no draft is pending. So a new app shown per A3, in `?preview=draft` with the draft bar as the one control, has its only real Publish hidden and a draft-bar Publish that does nothing, and "the app's unpublished changes" is a count of zero for an app that is wholly unpublished. That is card #34610's own acceptance 2 and 3 (new app in the main area, one Publish button), and its item 6 already separates "this app has never been published" from "N unpublished changes"; A3 drops that distinction. ADR-0037's new header line also says "the publish gate [is] unchanged" while its amended Decision routes every build through the draft overlay. Fix, text only: in the Building bullet (and the ADR-0037 Decision note) say the main area shows the app in the regime the build is in, the real unpublished app per ADR-0045 for a new or still-unpublished app and `?preview=draft` for changes to a published app; name the one publish control as the shell's single bar for that regime (the two bars already never stack) with the card's two wordings; scope the change count to the mutation partition; cite ADR-0045 in "What it changes / what stands".

S1 (should-fix) — "One container … the only place the console draws the assistant's conversation" is wider than the tree after #34665. The Studio copilot keeps its own right dock (`StudioAiCopilot`, listed in this ADR's status line as "Studio right dock"), and its maximize still navigates to `/ai/build?package=PKG`, which now lands on Home with the drawer maximized: the Studio user loses the page they were on, the exact defect A3's "Why" cites, and the dev report lists it as a deviation. The public `/s/:token` page also draws a conversation, read-only. A3 never names Studio; its Consequences line about "a page not wrapped by a drawer host" covers the link, not the second dock. Record the carve-out: which surfaces keep their own chrome (Studio dock, the share page, the runtime bubble per §4), and that Studio's navigating maximize is a known remainder with an owner, or decide it.

S2 (should-fix) — the two files disagree on refresh cadence. A3 says the main area is "refreshed in place after each build turn"; ADR-0037, amended in this PR and declared otherwise standing, still says "refreshed per-artifact by the existing stream events", Phase 2 "re-keys/refetches the affected renderer per `(type, name)`" with acceptance "grows artifact-by-artifact in step with the build tree … in under 1 s". Today's code is per-artifact (coalesced `emitCanvasInvalidate`, which `MetadataProvider` already subscribes to in the shell itself, so the in-place canvas loses nothing). A dev following A3 literally regresses Phase 2's acceptance to once per turn. Say "per ADR-0037 Phase 2" in A3, or amend Phase 2's acceptance if per-turn is what was ruled (card #34610 item 1 says 每轮搭建后).

Nit — the ADR's TL;DR decision 3 ("Full-page `/ai` becomes the same panel maximized"), the Status line ("maximized `/ai`"), the P3 rollout bullet and the Consumers and References lists (`layout/ConsoleChatbotFab.tsx`, deleted by #34665) are left unmarked; the `Amended` header covers them, a pointer on TL;DR 3 would save a reader.
Nit — "Why" rests on epic #34571 comment 6936163971 (the 310 px measurement). That comment is outside this review's inputs and was not read; the citation is unverified here, not doubted.

**`docs/adr/0037-live-canvas-draft-preview.md`**

Against ruling 6937505798: the split view ("chat on the left … draft overlay on the right") and the `LiveCanvas` host are struck with pointers to A3, and rule 3's floating-button sentence is replaced, as ruled. Boundary rules 1, 2 and 4 hold unchanged under the new presentation (no canvas store, no in-place edit, existing publish endpoints), and Phase 4's back-channel gets simpler with the canvas in the same document.

M1 applies to this file's Decision note and `Amended` header line as written above.

Nit — Phase 2's acceptance still says "the right pane grows"; after the amendment the right side is the chat. Fold into the S2 edit.
Nit — Phase 2 still names "both chat hosts (`ConsoleFloatingChatbot`, `AiChatPage`)", the Status line still lists `LiveCanvas` as the implementation, and the altitude table still says "AI chat (floating / Build-with-AI)". Stale before this PR; unmarked by it.

Result: one must-fix (M1), two should-fix (S1, S2). The #34608 half of A3 is sound against its consumer; the #34610 half needs the ADR-0045 regime written in before it is the contract #34610 is built to.

**M1 (regimes, one Publish): answered.**
- A3 "What it changes" now lists as standing "ADR-0037's draft overlay and its per-artifact refresh (Phase 2), and ADR-0045's regimes: a new or still-unpublished app is materialized, real and unlisted, and published by the visibility flip; changes to a published app are drafts, published by publishing them." = ADR-0045 §3, §5.
- "Building": main area shows the app "in the regime the build is in (ADR-0045)": real unlisted app for a new or still-unpublished app, `?preview=draft` for changes to a published app; after binding it "shows that app" (no longer "that app's draft"). = ADR-0045 §5/§7 and ruling 6937505798 ("the app draft itself in the main area" read per regime).
- New "One publish control": one Publish = "the shell's bar for the regime the main area is in. The two bars never stack (the unpublished-app bar yields in draft mode)". Checked in the tree: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/UnpublishedAppBar.tsx` ~64 "never stack both bars", `if (preview) return null`. The two wordings ("never been published" / "N unpublished changes") are #34610 item 6's. Count = the current package's pending drafts, shown the same in bar, changes panel and chat; the chat draws no Publish of its own. = ruling ("one publish button and one change count").
- ADR-0037: `Amended` line now states both regimes and drops "the publish gate [is] unchanged"; the Decision note splits the two regimes and cites ADR-0045. Consistent with A3.

**S1 (carve-outs): answered.** "One container" is scoped to the console shell (Home and every app page) and names the three surfaces that keep their own chrome: Studio's copilot in its right slot (`StudioAiCopilot.tsx` cites objectui#12725 at ~154/~170), `/s/:token` (read-only, ADR-0013), the runtime bubble (§4). It also decides that Studio's maximize "widens the copilot's slot in place instead (objectstack#34610)". See note 1.

**S2 (refresh cadence): answered.** A3 now says "refreshes in place per artifact, as ADR-0037 Phase 2 already specifies, and once more when a build turn ends"; ADR-0037 Phase 2 acceptance amended "right pane" → "main area". The two files agree, and Phase 2's per-artifact acceptance is kept.

**Nits folded:** A3 header line now names the ADR-0037 scope (my earlier note); §3 TL;DR item 3 carries an A3 pointer; `ConsoleChatbotFab.tsx` marked "deleted by Amendment A3" in Consumers; ADR-0037 Phase 2's host list carries an A3 note.

**Gates, this head (local):** `check-adr-links` ✅ 1145 resolve, `check-adr-anchors` exit 0, `adr-index --report` OK. CI on this head was pushed minutes before this read; the seat reads it green before hand-over.

Must-fix: none. Should-fix (seat, record only): the claim-surface item from my first two reads stands (ADR-0037 now edited in five places).

## Notes for the seat and the maintainer's read
1. **Studio's maximize is a decision the rulings did not word.** Both rulings speak of the console assistant; A3 now extends "maximize is in place" to Studio's copilot and names #34610 as owner. It follows the maintainer's own words on #34608 (「全屏之后也可以收缩回来…而不要跳转页面」) and closes the contract review's S1 remainder, so I accept it, but it is new contract text for the maintainer to see on hand-over. #34610's claim surface (6939422606) does not list `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/**`; it needs that when the work starts.
2. "Shows a receipt once a publish lands" in the chat is presentation detail under "one publish button"; no new decision.
